reason: I already pay an agency to handle Instagram and creators, and I'm on the counter from 7 to 2, so I don't have time to train staff on PINs and coupons for a beta app. Free plus paying me ₹200 a month sounds like it'll change the moment I rely on it.
objection: Free now, but once my staff are used to it and my creator collabs run through it, you'll start charging or shut down. And ₹200 a month and ₹150 referrals mean nothing to a business my size; it feels like a gimmick.
would_change_my_mind: My agency running it for me, plus a written commitment on what it will cost after the pilot, and proof from a salon like mine that the coupons brought in real paying customers.
